card.name: Diagnostic evaluation and work-up wording
card.fires_on: The word "evaluation" after "diagnostic", "up" or "-up" in "work-up", and "evaluated" after "further", in text about investigating a patient before or during treatment.

modes.label: Diagnostic evaluation
modes.description: "evaluation" or "evaluated" following "diagnostic" or "further" when describing assessment of a patient.
modes.example: The diagnostic<< evaluation>> of patients with this syndrome is complicated.

modes.label: Work-up
modes.description: The end of "workup" or "work-up" meaning a set of tests to find a cause.
modes.example: initiate appropriate work<<up>> to exclude alternative etiologies, including
